description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractComposite in PHP that is part of a validation framework for an HRM system. It manages a collection of rules and provides a method to validate input against a composite rule, dynamically instantiating rule classes using reflection.

classes.name: AbstractComposite
classes.description: An abstract class representing a composite validation rule that combines multiple sub-rules and validates input through a dynamically constructed composite rule class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the composite rule with a variable number of Rule objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input by instantiating each sub-rule via reflection and applying the composite rule validation.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses that returns the class name of the composite rule.
